question: Whether prior work combines target-excluded auxiliary-species pretraining, a matched same-architecture target-only control, and whole-region geographic exclusion for transfer evaluation in species distribution modelling.
conclusion: No exact predecessor was identified in this bounded check; this supports a calibrated novelty statement, not a claim of priority.
scope: Six close precedents selected for the manuscript bibliography; primary publication records and full text or proceedings pages were checked for metadata and study-design boundaries.

records.relevance: Early deep multispecies embedding with single-species and multispecies comparisons.
records.boundary: Five-fold cross-validation in BCR13; no staged target-excluded auxiliary pretraining or whole-region transfer test identified.

records.relevance: Large multispecies deep-learning community model evaluated with independent expert surveys.
records.boundary: No matched target-only network, staged target-excluded pretraining, or held-region transfer design identified.

records.relevance: Transfers presence-only representation learning to abundance SDMs and compares transfer against no transfer.
records.boundary: Source and target differ by response/data type; spatial-block cross-validation is not a target-excluded auxiliary-species pretraining experiment with a closed geographic holdout.

records.relevance: Transfers information from common to rare species through a hierarchical prior and compares against single-species models.
records.boundary: Randomized two-fold splitting over 53 sites; method is hierarchical prior transfer rather than a neural encoder tested under geographic transfer.

records.relevance: Few-shot range estimation for evaluation species excluded from multispecies training.
records.boundary: Tests transfer to unseen species, not a same-architecture target-only control or whole-region geographic exclusion.

records.relevance: Sequential multispecies deep learning with fine-tuning and experience replay under data scarcity.
records.boundary: Uses random 80/20 calibration and augmented target data; no whole-region exclusion or target-excluded auxiliary stage identified.
